body:
I summarized my findings in my intent to change this on blink-dev, which didn't get support:
https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/d/msg/blink-dev/QrgyulnqvmE/370xN494sroJ

No Chromium-based browser that I know of uses the empty string, and even if they did I'm not sure I would want to allow it. The less variation the better, I'd say.

I'm downloading a VM with Edge to see what their vendor string is. They will fall into the Chrome bucket, and I think it would make good sense for them to just use "Google Inc.", but if they should come back and say "no can do" then we'd just have to treat that like Blink's disinterest in changing, and adjust the spec somehow.
